title: Fourier expansion of a point mass
statement: For every dimension $n$ and every point $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the density of the singleton set containing the zero vector, evaluated at $x$, equals the sum of all characters: $\operatorname{density}_{\{0\}}(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}\chi_S(x)$.
